title: selinum coriandrum
intro: Selinum coriandrum, commonly known as Wild Coriander or Lesser Coriander, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a natural remedy that offers several health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use as a carminative, expectorant, and diuretic, which help to relieve symptoms such as bloating, coughs, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of Selinum coriandrum include terpenoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
